article.title: Amendment of Act 18 of 1891.
article.content:
93Amendment of Act 18 of 1891.

93. [Amendment of Act 18 of 1891.]—Omitted by Act 10 of 2009, s. 48 (w.e.f. 27-10-2009).
Note: this section had amended the Banker's Books Evidence Act, 1891.
